# Floating drawings on blank lines

Original independent controls generated by `tools/floating_blank_fixture.py`.
Sixteen pages compare plain and floating-picture paragraphs containing no text,
one/two ASCII spaces, tab, NBSP, thin space, a letter, and a letter plus space.
The paragraph mark is 10 pt Arial; the text run is 24 pt Arial. The picture is
page-positioned with no wrapping, behind text. The small red PNG is generated
by the script; no corpus content or external artwork is included.

`native.pdf` was exported from the pinned `source.docx` using the reference
application. `tools/record_floating_blank.py` records Before/After baselines
and hashes. Ordinary spaces/tabs leave height controlled by the paragraph mark
even with the floating picture. NBSP, thin space and visible text retain their
own font metrics. Existing inline-picture controls cover the separate inline
object height rules. This records reference behavior not an explicit OOXML formula.
